    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the Private Broadcast label and directly affects transaction relay and origin privacy by suppressing clearnet peer announcement on wallet rebroadcasts.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.8,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a privacy leak that deanonymizes the node as the transaction origin over clearnet P2P connections despite the user enabling `-privatebroadcast`. Leaving an opt-in private broadcast mechanism actively leaking origin on periodic resubmissions causes serious privacy harm across a release cycle."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the Wallet label and modifies wallet rebroadcast behavior in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.78,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents wallet resubmission logic from compromising user privacy by broadcasting unconfirmed wallet transactions to all peers when private broadcast is requested. A transaction that was broadcast privately could previously be rebroadcast over clearnet 24-36 hours later, revealing node ownership of the wallet."
    }
